story.text: At the White Hart, Anne and Captain Harville argue over who loves longest, men or women. Wentworth sits {WRITING} by the window, and his pen falls. “All the {PRIVILEGE} I claim for my own sex,” says Anne, “is that of loving longest, when {EXISTENCE} or when {HOPE} is gone.” Wentworth hurries out, comes back for his {GLOVES}, and slips away again after {PLACING} a letter before her.
story.caption: Placed it before Anne
